Database.//: Active EF Core provider: sqlite (default), postgres, or sqlserver. Set ConnectionStrings:Default to match. SQLite applies migrations on boot; postgres/sqlserver create the schema from the model (EnsureCreated) until you add migrations for them. A dev/prod split is just a different Provider per environment file.

Seed.//: Initial administrator, seeded idempotently on boot. Development uses local defaults; production requires Seed:Admin:Email + Seed:Admin:Password (set them via environment variables or user-secrets, not here). DemoData seeds the sample users + Sales data outside Development (e.g. a public demo).

Demo.//: Public-demo control channel. Set ControlKey to a long random secret to let an external admin (the configurator) drive /api/demo (reset / baseline / factory-reset / schedule) via the X-Demo-Control-Key header. Blank means key auth is off (the in-app demo.manage permission still works). Put the real key in appsettings.Production.json / env vars, not here.

Email.//: Leave FromAddress + Smtp:Host blank to log emails to the console (dev). Set both to send via any SMTP relay (Brevo: smtp-relay.brevo.com:587, STARTTLS). Keep the password in env vars / user-secrets, not here.
